2026-07-06 Korea

Korea Day 3

ICML

ICML officially starts!
First talk, AI for math research
TD at ICML - Our chief scientist giving a talk on Trusworthy AI
Gangnam Style sculpture out of venue, lol
Had some raw crab for lunch. First time having it raw, and it was really good!

Gwanghwamun Square

After lunch, I wanted to go to Gwanghwamun Square, but it started pouring and we decided not to. There was a libray in the venue that I decided to checkout in the meantime (Startfield Library).

After checking it out, the rain stopped so I want to go to Gwanghwamun Square. However, as soon as I got to the bus station, it started pouring again. Between the back and forth, I probably lost and hour, but went to the square anyway. Thankfully the rain stopped for good and managed to see the gate and palace just before they closed for the day.

Interesting fact: if you were hanboks to the palace, you don't need to pay for entry
I like how this contrasts the old and new architectures
The detailes on the roof are crazy
They have an interesting exhibition of what a village looked like half a century ago
They had a restaurant, school, cafe, barber shop, etc., in the style of that time. The school was particularly interesting
The traditional houses in Bukchon are a sight to behold

Bukchon Hanok Village

Since this is also a residential area, a curfew has been imposed to avoid tourists from disturbing the residents. There are tons of signs in the area of local business opposing this. Don't have enough context to have an opinion on this, unfortunately it did mean I didn't really get to see much this time.

Dinner

With coworkers, we had to switch last minute our dinner plan as the original restaurant had a 40 min queue. Grabbed some Korean BBQ (organ edition) including intestines, tripe, and something I don't remember, lol.
